probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Outkast ® Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast Menu Outkast ® Close Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast Six European fashion titles in one year Mavetti, hand stitched loafers from the Marche. Services Media relations Year 2025 A family shoemaker with no press history. Twelve months of desk sides, samples and studio visits took Mavetti into the fashion pages of six European titles. The brief Mavetti has made loafers in the same workshop for three generations and had never spoken to a journalist. The family wanted to sell beyond Italy without changing how they work, which meant no influencer seeding and no discounting. What we did We built a year around the workshop. Each month one fashion editor visited the Marche, watched a pair being stitched and left with their own size six weeks later. Between visits we ran desk sides in Milan, Madrid and Copenhagen with a single pair and the last it was built on. What ran Six fashion titles in four countries covered the brand within the year, and the waiting list for a pair grew from three weeks to four months.
